one_line: Baseline MLP and dataset claims partially replicated; exemplar generalization gap confirmed; GNN/Transformer and Conv subsets not tested.
justification: C1 is confirmed as the dataset was downloaded and used successfully. C2 is partially replicated as the baseline MLP achieved comparable R² for dense subsets but with discrepancies in SMAPE/RMSE. C3 was not tested due to compute constraints. C4 is confirmed as the exemplar generalization gap was observed with negative R² for BRAM and poor performance on other targets. C5 is partially addressed as only dense subsets were tested, leaving Conv1D/Conv2D unverified. Overall, the replication is partial due to scope limitations.
